description: This file contains unit tests for socket stream text communication within the WPEFramework project, including a custom TextConnector class that manages socket communication and synchronization for testing purposes.

classes.name: TextConnector
classes.description: A custom class derived from Core::StreamTextType to handle socket stream communication with synchronization features for testing.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles incoming text data, either submitting it if acting as a server socket or storing it for retrieval.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Blocks until data is pending, indicating data has been received.

methods.name: Retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the received data and clears the internal buffer.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Placeholder for sending data over the socket (not implemented).

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state changes, signaling when the socket is open.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Returns the current static state indicating if the server socket is active.
